# Decouple Runner from UI Implementation Details

## Context

`src/runner/workflow.rs` directly instantiates `BivvyTheme::new()` for formatting
step headers/status messages, calls `live_output_callback()` from the spinner
module, and creates raw `println!` callbacks — all bypassing the existing
`UserInterface` trait abstraction. This makes the runner untestable in isolation
and tightly coupled to terminal-specific implementation details.

## Approach

Add new methods to the existing `UserInterface` and `SpinnerHandle` traits with
sensible defaults, then update the runner to use them instead of reaching into
UI internals.

## Changes

### 1. `src/ui/mod.rs` — New trait methods

**`UserInterface` gets 3 formatting methods + 1 callback method:**

```rust
/// Format a step header line: "[1/7] name — title".
fn format_step_header(&self, index: usize, total: usize, name: &str, title: &str) -> String {
    // Default: plain text, no styling
}

/// Format an indented skip message: "    ○ {msg}".
fn format_skipped(&self, msg: &str) -> String {
    format!("    ○ {}", msg)
}

/// Format an indented blocked message: "    ⊘ {msg}".
fn format_blocked(&self, msg: &str) -> String {
    format!("    ⊘ {}", msg)
}

/// Create an output callback for non-interactive verbose streaming.
fn create_verbose_output_callback(&self) -> Option<crate::shell::OutputCallback> {
    None
}
```

**`SpinnerHandle` gets 1 callback method:**

```rust
/// Create a live output callback that updates the spinner with command output.
fn create_output_callback(
    &self,
    base_message: String,
    indent: usize,
    max_lines: usize,
) -> Option<crate::shell::OutputCallback> {
    None
}
```

### 2. `src/ui/terminal.rs` — Override formatting methods

`TerminalUI` overrides `format_step_header`, `format_skipped`, `format_blocked`
to use `self.theme` for styled output.

### 3. `src/ui/spinner.rs` — Override `create_output_callback`

`ProgressSpinner` implements `create_output_callback` by calling the existing
`live_output_callback()` with its internal progress bar. Encapsulates the
`indicatif::ProgressBar` detail within the spinner.

### 4. `src/ui/non_interactive.rs` — Override `create_verbose_output_callback`

`NonInteractiveUI` returns a `println!`-based callback when in verbose mode.

### 5. `src/ui/mock.rs` — No changes

`MockUI` and `MockSpinner` inherit the default implementations. The defaults
produce plain text containing the same keywords as the current themed output,
so existing `has_message("skipped")` assertions continue to pass.

### 6. `src/runner/workflow.rs` — Use trait methods

Remove these imports:
- `crate::ui::spinner::live_output_callback`
- `crate::ui::theme::BivvyTheme`
- `StatusKind` (no longer needed in runner)

Remove `let theme = BivvyTheme::new();` (line 317).

Replace all theme formatting with the new trait method calls:
- `theme.format_skipped(...)` → `ui.format_skipped(...)`
- `StatusKind::Blocked.format(&theme, ...)` → `ui.format_blocked(...)`
- Step header formatting → `ui.format_step_header(index, total, name, title)`
- Output callback creation → `spinner.create_output_callback(...)` + `ui.create_verbose_output_callback()`

## Verification

1. `cargo test --all-features` — all existing + new tests pass
2. `cargo fmt -- --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
3. `cargo doc --no-deps --all-features`
4. `cargo llvm-cov --all-features` — coverage >= 90%
5. `cargo build --all-targets --all-features && cargo build --release`
6. Confirm `workflow.rs` has zero imports from `crate::ui::theme` or `crate::ui::spinner`
